findings.description: Prod guard classifies using ONLY the first DNS label (host.split('.')[0]). For vanity/custom domains the first label is not the instance name. Bypass: production served at 'dev.acmecorp.com' is classified sub-prod -> writes allowed against PRODUCTION. Conversely a real sub-prod at 'snow.acmedev.com' is blocked. The first-label assumption only holds for *.service-now.com.
findings.suggested_fix: Restrict first-label heuristic to *.service-now.com hosts; default-DENY vanity hosts (require explicit per-host allow) or classify against the full host with prod-marker winning.

findings.description: apiWrite has no login-redirect detection (apiGet has it at 52-54). Expired session: write answered 302 -> 200 HTML login page; res.ok true, res.json() throws on HTML, catch returns { ok: true, data: undefined }. A write that never happened is reported as SUCCESS, corrupting create/read-back/delete flows.
findings.suggested_fix: Mirror apiGet: check res.redirected && /login|sso/i.test(res.url) -> 401; verify JSON content-type or handle 204 explicitly instead of swallowing parse failure as success.

findings.description: X-UserToken (g_ck CSRF) attached unconditionally to any URL, including the caller-supplied 'text' op URL. Off-instance URL would leak the CSRF token in the request header. Latent (current callers pass builder URLs) but 'text' also bypasses the prod guard and can reach state-changing GET processors.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate target URL origin === https://<req.host> before attaching X-UserToken / fetching, in apiGetText and the text-op dispatch.

findings.description: No fetch timeout/AbortController anywhere. A stalled connection hangs executeApiRequest forever; the runtime message reply never arrives; side-panel operation hangs with no failure path. Worst for apiBgRun (sys.scripts.do).
findings.suggested_fix: AbortController with sensible timeout (longer for bgrun); map abort to { ok:false, status:0, error:'Timed out' }.

findings.description: apiGetText lacks login-redirect detection. Expired session returns login HTML as ok data; downstream XML parsing processes a login page as record XML -> confusing errors / silently empty imports instead of 'session expired'.
findings.suggested_fix: Same res.redirected && /login|sso/ check as apiGet; optionally verify body starts with '<?xml'.

findings.description: Table name interpolated into encoded query; a name containing '^' injects query operators into the sys_dictionary read. Read-only, table normally from page context — limited impact.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate table against /^[a-z0-9_]+$/i in buildDictionaryUrl and buildChoicesQuery.

findings.description: The two most security-critical modules have no tests. Guard gate in apiWrite/apiBgRun, write-op dispatch, 401/redirect handling, re-injection retry are uncovered; a regression moving the guard after fetch would not be caught.
findings.suggested_fix: Unit tests with mocked fetch: writes 403 on prod and never call fetch; 401 when token null; login-redirect path; 204 handling.

findings.description: Broad substrings 'demo'/'training' match anywhere in the label, permitting destructive writes on production-grade instances whose names contain them. Deliberate config choice (MFEC uses 'demo') but widens allow surface.
findings.suggested_fix: Tighten/anchor riskiest patterns; document fleet scoping; consider explicit allowlist.

purpose_notes.purpose: Default-DENY classifier (handoff decision 5). Prod marker checked FIRST so it wins over sub-prod matches; unmatched stays 'unknown' -> blocked. Ordering is the safety property; must not be reordered. Lookbehinds exempt sub/pre/non-prod from forced block.
Single choke point for create/update/delete. classifyInstance BEFORE any fetch (403 if not allowed), then requires X-UserToken (401), then same-origin fetch. All three write ops route through here.

Second guarded write path: server-side Rhino via sys.scripts.do. Guarded + token-required like apiWrite. Update set injected via JSON.stringify to prevent script-context breakout. sysparm_ck carries g_ck for classic-form CSRF.
Exhaustive op dispatcher; authorization boundary — reads open, writes guarded. 'text' is the one authenticated GET with caller-supplied URL.
Best-effort extraction of ServiceNow error.message/detail from failed JSON bodies without throwing on non-JSON.

Routes API requests to active tab's top-frame content script (page-origin fetch carries SameSite cookie). Self-heals 'Receiving end does not exist' after extension reload by re-injecting declared content scripts, 150ms wait, one retry; other errors rethrown.

unclear_code.why_unclear: Injected by content/index.ts:91 (out of scope for T-101). If guardConfig were page-influenced, a broad pattern would neutralize the guard. Needs cross-check with T-104.
preprod/nonprod exempted from forced BLOCK but not in default sub-prod patterns -> still blocked as 'unknown'. No observable effect under default config; intent undocumented.
